scopeNote: Programme decisions made during MC-10. They mirror MC10-DECISION-REGISTER.md and the programme DECISION-LOG.md entries. They never approve a price, a product release or a commercial commitment.

decisions.title: MC-10 stops at the outreach authorization gate and reports BLOCKED, not PASS
decisions.summary: No explicit, dated and scoped customer-outreach authorization exists, so no candidate may be identified or contacted and no interview may be counted. MC-10 delivers the complete Wave 0 preparation package, records fieldwork as NOT_EXECUTED and reports BLOCKED instead of converting preparation into an apparent primary-research PASS.
decisions.statusEffect: No participant, interview or price evidence exists; no commercial status changes.

decisions.title: The MC-09 priority order remains unvalidated and no product or bundle advances
decisions.summary: Absence of primary evidence is not evidence of absence. The nine families and six bundles keep their MC-09 desk-research priorities and are classified NOT_TESTED in MC-10. No product may be advanced, deferred or discontinued on the basis of zero interviews, and no product readiness is upgraded.
decisions.statusEffect: No lifecycle change; no readiness upgrade; no investment approval.

decisions.title: Instruments and experiment thresholds are frozen before fielding; Portuguese versions are withheld
decisions.summary: The MC-09 instrument suite is frozen as version 1.0.0 with recorded source hashes; any change requires a dated amendment and a new version. The ten experiment thresholds are frozen from the MC-09 registry and verified by hash. Portuguese instruments are deliberately not produced without qualified linguistic review, so northern Portugal cannot be fielded.
decisions.statusEffect: A post-hoc threshold or instrument change would be detectable and is prohibited.

decisions.title: No commercial restriction is weakened by MC-10 and stated preference remains NOT_MEASURED
decisions.summary: Trademark, IP, sales, publication, deployment, profitability, PILOT safety, compatibility and price approvals are unchanged. Because zero pricing modules were administered, WTP_STATED_PREFERENCE_OBSERVED and WTP_COMMERCIALLY_VALIDATED remain false and APPROVED_PRICES remains 0.
decisions.statusEffect: No price approval, publication, order path or commercial claim.

decisions.title: MC-11 cannot inherit customer evidence and must first unblock fieldwork or explicitly re-scope
decisions.summary: MC-11 (hardware, supplier, conformity and feasibility) receives no customer-validation input from MC-10 because none was collected. Its handoff separates hardware/supplier questions that can be researched internally from customer questions that remain blocked behind AUTH-MC10-001.
decisions.statusEffect: No hardware, BOM, supplier order or conformity claim is authorised.
